newsitem.title: USA: IMM currencies end mixed; yen sales seen late.
newsitem.headline: IMM currencies end mixed; yen sales seen late.

text.p: Dec 17 - IMM currency futures finished mixed, with most contracts logging only light volume. Yen ended up but off highs. Sales totalling up to 1,000 contracts seen in March yen late, trimming earlier gains. Fed inactivity and a recovery in stocks helped the dollar and capped currencies, traders said.
